description: Ranks all 13 supported US resale platforms by profit for the same sale (each platform's default options). Returns fees, payout, profit and margin per platform, with a link to each fliprofit.com calculator and the side-by-side compare tool.

itemCost.description: What you paid for the item, USD (default 0).

otherCost.description: Packaging, promotion and other costs, USD (default 0).

shipCharged.description: Shipping the buyer paid you, USD (default 0).

taxRate.description: Buyer sales tax percent, e.g. 8 (default 0). Used where the platform charges fees on tax.

name: compare_platforms
title: Compare all platforms for one sale
